node: Defense subtier suppliers below prime contractors
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around defense subtier suppliers where policy-driven defense spending may expose hidden capacity, qualification, and supplier-visibility bottlenecks. The reference lane uses RTX as a prime/customer-context anchor because its missile, air-defense, propulsion, and aerospace programs depend on deep supplier networks. The underfollowed lane prioritizes smaller or mid-cap public companies with direct evidence of supplying aerospace/defense electronics, structures, composite materials, test systems, or program-critical components. Key caveat: inclusion is not a recommendation; later layers must verify program-level exposure, qualification status, margin conversion, backlog durability, and whether prime contract funding actually passes down.
